scripts.dev: npm run dev:docker && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000
scripts.lint: npm --workspace frontend run lint && cd backend && ./vendor/bin/pint --test
